 By Emily Cureton Cook ( OPB ) and Jen Baires ( OPB ) BEND, Ore. Oct. 23, 2026 2:18 p.m. In an exclusive interview with OPB, Kaylub Giamanco, the man who fatally shot the teenage school shooter at Silver Rail Elementary, shares what he wants people to know about his experience.
